## What and why

Describe the change, the problem it solves, and any related issue.

## Verification

List the exact tests or checks run and their results. Explain any checks not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] Added or updated regression tests where applicable.
- [ ] Added a CHANGELOG.md entry for user-visible changes (or explained why none is needed).
- [ ] Updated affected documentation.
- [ ] Removed tokens, private hostnames, addresses and conversation content from logs and fixtures.
- [ ] Screenshots use synthetic data only (attach them for UI changes).
